name: Cyberpunk Neon
tagline: Black-violet night with cyan, magenta and yellow neon glow, glitch-split Orbitron headlines, chamfered HUD panels and a pixel skyline (extended from a single-slide specimen)

palette.description: near-black violet ground with cyan, magenta and yellow neon accents and faint cyan grid lines

typography.style: wide geometric display caps with RGB-split glitch shadow over a tracked monospace body

best_for: Security, gaming and developer-culture talks that want an unapologetic neon terminal look, with chamfered metric panels for numbers.
avoid_for: Formal, conservative or emotional audiences where glow and glitch effects feel noisy.
